raw_html: [[Alchemical Crafting|Alchemical (Prototype)]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Alchemical Crafting|Alchemical (Prototype)]]:''' This experimental item, crafted and enchanted at ancient Cannith creation forges using powerful alchemy, is made of a material that allows elemental power sources to be bound to it. This item is in a prototype state and is currently in need of refinement before an elemental can be bound to it.
